Endpoints jo kaam karte hain

Ek key, infinite possibilities — music bots, downloaders, AI agents

🎵 /api/stream — instant audio/video URL
GET /api/stream?url=https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ&type=audio&api_key=YOUR_KEY

→ { "stream_url": "https://.../file/xyz", "cached": true, "latency": "0.02s" }
🔍 /search — YouTube search, innertube fast-path
GET /search?q=kesariya&limit=5&api_key=YOUR_KEY

→ { "results": [ { "id": "BddP6PYo2gs", "title": "Kesariya — Brahmastra", ... } ] }
📡 /info + /formats + /file/{id} — full toolkit
GET /info?url=YT_URL&api_key=KEY   → title, duration, thumbnail, uploader
GET /file/{id}?api_key=KEY          → zero-proxy audio/video file streaming
